info.name: Langtrace AI Projects Prompt Registry API
Get a prompt from the registry.

params.name: promptset_id
params.description: ID of the prompt registry, found in the Langtrace UI.

params.name: version
params.description: Prompt version to fetch. Defaults to the live prompt.

items.docs: Fetches a prompt set from the prompt registry. If no version is provided the live prompt is returned; if there are no live prompts an error is thrown. Dynamic variables may be supplied using variables.<variable_name> query parameters.
